defect.symptom: The second five-minute MULTUP/MULTDOWN snapshot pair failed with 'Connect to Deriv before making a request.'
defect.cause: V1 kept one public proposal WebSocket idle between snapshot cycles. Deriv closed it before the second cycle, and V1 did not establish a fresh bounded connection.
defect.effect: Continuing would have retained healthy tick data but mostly failed proposal snapshots. No profitability conclusion can be drawn.
defect.resolution: V2 opens one connection for each two-proposal cycle, permits six connections, has zero retries per cycle, and preserves the same 18-message request ceiling.
